senses.gloss:
† भन्द् भन्द्, 1. 1, Ātm.
 1. To be fortunate.
 2. To make fortunate.
 3. To worship.
 4. To be excellent.
 5. To be glad.
 6. To exhilarate.
 7. To shine.
 --i. 10, Par. To make fortunate; cf. भद्र.

भान भान, i. e. भा + अन, n.
 1. Appearance, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 3.
 2. Perception, Bhāṣāp. 65.
 --Cf. ϕανός.
भानतस् भान + तस्, adv. In consequence of the appearance, Vedāntas. in Chr. 202, 5.
भानवन्त् भान + वन्त्, adj. Endowed with the appearance, Vedāntas. in Chr. 217, 3.

भानु भा + नु,
 I. m.
 1. A ray of light, Chr. 288, 9 = Rigv. i. 48, 9.
 2. Light.
 3. The sun, Pañc. 134, 17.
 4. A sovereign, a master.
 II. f. A handsome woman.
 --Comp.

भानुमन्त् भानु + मन्त्, adj., f. मती.
 1. Luminous, splendid.
 2. Beautiful, Draup. 7, 2.
